summary: An Elf Ranger fires runed arrows from an elven bow. When the second volley arrow hits an iron golem, the JS hmon_hitmon_weapon_melee path evaluates ELVEN_BOW for C's elven launcher damage bonus but the constant is not imported, stopping the replay.

source.branch: hmon_hitmon_weapon_melee checks thrown ammunition after the melee damage setup. For a thrown elven arrow, it verifies the elf race and ELVEN_ARROW, then checks whether the hero's launcher is ELVEN_BOW before adding one damage. C declares this branch at uhitm.c:1053-1058; JS mirrors it but leaves ELVEN_BOW out of its objects.js imports.

evidence: Read nethack-c/upstream/src/uhitm.c:933-1067. The thrown ammunition arm at 1050-1063 uses Race_if(PM_ELF), ELVEN_ARROW and ELVEN_BOW in order, adding one damage only when ammo_and_launcher succeeds.

Read js/uhitm.js:2753-2885. Its corresponding thrown-arrow arm already mirrors those conditions and reads ELVEN_ARROW, but ELVEN_BOW is absent from the objects.js import list. js/objects.js exports ELVEN_BOW.

The admitted prefix receipt matches 310 screens and cursors and 2099 RNG values before the error at step 310. The evaluation records the stopped replay as 0 complete matches across 362 screens, 2145 RNG values and 362 cursors. Its C outcome shows the second runed arrow hitting the iron golem; the production path reaches hmon_hitmon_weapon_melee through hmon_hitmon_weapon -> hmon_hitmon -> hmon -> thitmonst -> throwit.
